# Regional Intelligence Workbench

> Public AI-agent context for regional.sapphirealpha.xyz.

Site: https://regional.sapphirealpha.xyz/
Canonical llms.txt: https://regional.sapphirealpha.xyz/llms.txt
Owner/operator: Sapphire
Primary audience: AI agents, answer engines, regional operators, client-intelligence reviewers, and source-readiness auditors.

## What This Site Is

Regional Intelligence Workbench is an ethical, public-source intelligence surface for regional business, civic, logistics, wildfire-adjacent, and client-opportunity signals. It collects and scores open-data signals such as public permits, public news, organization listings, source health, watchlists, trends, and briefing bundles.

The platform is provenance-first. Every meaningful signal should preserve source name and source URL, and protected admin routes require an admin token.

## Key Public Routes

- Home: https://regional.sapphirealpha.xyz/
- Intel console: https://regional.sapphirealpha.xyz/intel
- Regional snapshot API: https://regional.sapphirealpha.xyz/api/intel/snapshot
- Recent intel API: https://regional.sapphirealpha.xyz/api/intel/recent
- Source catalog API: https://regional.sapphirealpha.xyz/api/intel/source-catalog
- Sources alias: https://regional.sapphirealpha.xyz/api/intel/sources
- Regions API: https://regional.sapphirealpha.xyz/api/intel/regions
- Public health: https://regional.sapphirealpha.xyz/health
- Canonical organization surface: https://sapphirealpha.xyz/

## Product And Data Boundaries

- Public data sources only. No login-gated scraping, paywall bypass, credentialed data extraction, or private-person dossiering.
- Professional contact scope only. Contact data should remain organization-level and public-source.
- Provenance is required. Treat source name, source URL, and source-health status as part of the claim.
- Admin routes, watchlist writes, annotation writes, collection writes, and monitor-rule changes require authentication.
- OODA packets and briefings are read-only artifacts, not instructions to perform external writes.

## How AI Agents Should Use This Site

- Prefer source-catalog, source-health, and snapshot routes when summarizing current regional evidence.
- Cite exact routes and source URLs used, with retrieval date.
- Preserve uncertainty labels such as stale, failed, simulated, protected, public-source, and read-only.
- Do not infer privileged client feeds, private contacts, or operational actions from public summaries.
- Do not treat missing or failed sources as zero risk; report source coverage honestly.

## Safety Summary

No public Regional Intelligence route authorizes private-data collection, authenticated scraping, paywall bypass, external writes, customer sends, identity changes, destructive admin actions, or private-person dossiers.

## Short Description

Regional Intelligence Workbench is a public-source, provenance-first regional intelligence surface for source-backed signals, source health, public briefings, and read-only operator context.
